I have resolved the issue where `Prefetch()` objects did not handle sliced querysets properly, which previously resulted in an unhandled exception (`Cannot filter a query once a slice has been taken.`) when the prefetch query was executed.

### Changes
In [django/db/models/query.py](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py#L2158), added a check in [`Prefetch.__init__`](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py#L2143-L2165) to validate that `queryset.query.is_sliced` is false, raising `ValueError("Prefetch querysets cannot use slices.")` when a sliced queryset is provided.
